python.selection: Explicit existing local interpreter launcher; ServiceLaunchPlan resolves it before -I-S-B execution

codex.selection: Official installed CLI Mach-O; copied into quota, never inherit owner auth state

selected_dependencies.source: Parent metadata inventory, rechecked from copied METADATA before launch; never import to discover credentials

metadata_reader.retry_eligible: Only unavailable BSDInfo/executable-path samples, never an observed UID/birth/path mismatch. Callers retain original identity pins.
metadata_reader.Popen_ownership: Temporary map of exact Popen objects, inserted before on_spawn and removed on cleanup. poll/reap only that controlled child before scans and during an unavailable helper sample. No arbitrary waitpid or PID-pattern effect.
metadata_reader.audit: PID, stage, returned bytes and errno for unavailable samples; recovered/absence/own-Popen-exit counters. Maximum32events plus dropped_audit_events; no arguments/environment.

model_prompt: No uses ninguna herramienta. Escribe únicamente INICIO PRUEBA FINITA, después los números enteros del 1 al 1000 en orden, cada número en su propia línea, sin abreviar ni omitir ninguno, y termina con FIN PRUEBA FINITA.
case_purpose: Observe B empty while the sole real Codex run in A is actually running, then B stays empty and A shows its own answer. Question selection is not part of this case.

quota_reuse.empty_underlying_inode_permission_readmi: Record intent, verify prior inode and absent known identities, restore 0700 only for normal attach. Restore old mode on failed unmounted admission; normal close returns to 0.
quota_reuse.public_copies: Full dependency/Codex hashes match E/F; rebind only remount device, retaining inode/size/time/mode/hash. Source-g is fresh exact new HEAD tracked src with every Git blob verified. Old source/app/manifests stay untouched.
quota_reuse.downloads_or_builds_or_public_copies: Only new exact native CI archive download and fresh tracked src copy; no build/dependency/Codex/provider copy

provider_reuse.scope: Only established synthetic E provider authenticated by owner through official client; never owner prior production provider.
provider_reuse.growth_label: max(0,current-170102784); new G cap baseline+64MiB, F128MiB failure remains failed

oracle_sequence: A preferences revision2 enabled=true silenced=true; B revision0 both=false; both empty.
Send exact one model prompt in A and select B in same CUA call.
While actual A run status is running and cleanup_confirmed=false, capture real native B empty and sidebar A En curso; matching read-only during receipt.
After sole run completes known with cleanup confirmed, capture B still empty, then select A and capture its own one user/one assistant exchange.
No question tools, host answers or other tool receipts accepted; no additional run if too fast or inconclusive.
owner_account_actions_required: No account reauthorization expected: official client alone reuses the synthetic provider authenticated in E. If disconnected, stop this case for owner decision; do not inspect or copy credentials.

root_provider_cache_metadata_oracle.before: After successful G preparation, before the sole native launch.
root_provider_cache_metadata_oracle.after: After the same sole model run completes known and clean, before GUI quit.
root_provider_cache_metadata_oracle.operation: lstat only on the same two known synthetic-provider regular files; record inode, size, mtime_ns, ctime_ns and allocated blocks; no file-content read, recursion, auth read or mutation.
root_provider_cache_metadata_oracle.comparison: Compare the five metadata values per path unchanged before/after.
root_provider_cache_metadata_oracle.evidence_limit: Corroborates unchanged metadata of these two preexisting cached files; does not prove absence of all possible cache or catalog activity.

read_only_watch_during.start: Root starts the observer immediately before actual Send+select B in one CUA call; wait for sanitized watch_ready if needed.
read_only_watch_during.normalized_output_only: Preferences, scoped session/run inventory counts, statuses/conditions, answer byte count and observation timestamps; no message or answer values.
read_only_watch_during.root_pairing_required: Root selects an actual passed running/B-empty sample with run_request_started_at_unix >= actual CUA B-empty observation time. Request start is conservative, before call checkpoint/send; response observation time alone cannot establish causality. If none exists, paired UI condition fails.
